en: Black‑and‑white night view of a large illuminated hilltop complex reflected in a river. The complex combines a Gothic church with twin spires and an attached castle‑like group of buildings with steep roofs and towers. Lights outline the structures and scatter through trees on the slope; a small boat is visible on the dark water in the foreground. There is no visible caption or writing on the image side.
